# credential-priority v1.1.11

## 更新内容

### 中文

- **统一耗尽禁用开关默认值**：Antigravity、Codex（免费与付费）以及 xAI（免费与周月）五个耗尽禁用配置项默认均设为关闭（不禁用）。凭据额度耗尽时默认仅降级优先级至 `-1`，用户主动开启对应开关后才会硬禁用凭据。
- **保留已有显式配置**：若已在配置中显式指定开关值（无论是开启还是关闭），原有配置继续保持生效，升级后无需重复调整。
- **管理页面与文档语义统一**：管理控制台配置提示、帮助说明与文档表述全面对齐，明确开关关闭表示不禁用、开启表示禁用，消除此前容易产生的理解歧义。
- **修复 Antigravity 零额度误提权问题**：修复后台自动排序探测逻辑，避免周重置时间在 24 小时以内但剩余额度为 0 的凭据被误提升至 999 优先级。额度耗尽凭据将稳定保持降级。
- **保持 Grok 与 xAI 字段向下兼容**：适应官方配额调整为周度周期的变化，继续兼容既有月度相关配置字段与解析规则，现有配置无需修改即可平滑过渡。

### English

- **Changes to depletion disable switch defaults**: All five quota-depleted disable settings across Antigravity, Codex (Free and Paid), and xAI (Free and weekly/monthly) now default to off (do not disable). Depleted credentials only have their priority lowered to `-1` by default, and they are hard-disabled only when you explicitly turn the switch on.
- **Preserve explicit existing configurations**: Any explicit `true` or `false` setting in your current configuration remains untouched. You don't need to change existing settings after updating.
- **Align management UI and documentation semantics**: Management page tooltips, help text, and documentation now consistently follow the convention where an off switch means keep enabled and an on switch means disable when depleted.
- **Fix Antigravity zero-quota 999 priority boost**: Fixed an issue where scheduled background sorting could boost an Antigravity credential to priority 999 when its reset time was within 24 hours even though remaining quota was already 0. Depleted credentials now stay demoted.
- **Retain Grok and xAI monthly field compatibility**: While upstream xAI and Grok quotas now use weekly cycles, existing monthly configuration fields and rules remain fully supported so existing setups keep running without changes.
